newsitem.title: UK: Three killed, dozens trapped in Russian explosion.
newsitem.headline: Three killed, dozens trapped in Russian explosion.

text.p: Three people were killed and dozens were trapped after an explosion wrecked an armed forces housing block in the southern Russian republic of Dagestan on Saturday, Russian media reported.

Itar-Tass news agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), said 49 people were still unaccounted for and that the presence of high concentrations of TNT residue at the site was hampering rescue efforts.
Forty-seven people had been rescued from the wreckage of the nine-storey building in Kaspiysk, which housed the families of border guard and air force personnel, said the agency.
It quoted the Ministry for Emergency Situations as saying three bodies had been recovered.
Russian Mayak radio, also monitored by the BBC, said the possibility of sabotage was not being ruled out.
No other information on the explosion or its cause was immediately available.
